standard.summary: Flow 预测目标（sdxl_model_prediction_type）：下列可选值说明含换档影响。
standard.effect: 不同枚举会改变算法目标、资源占用或导出兼容性。
standard.whenToUse: 先默认，再按显存/质量/兼容目标换档。
standard.avoidWhen: 未做短测对照前不要同时叠多个激进实验档。

optionDescriptions.velocity: 预测速度场 v，flow/RF 常见。
optionDescriptions.sample: 直接预测干净图；高噪声段往往更难训。

standard_en.summary: Flow prediction target (sdxl_model_prediction_type): the values below include what changing gear does.
standard_en.effect: Different enum values change the algorithm's target, its resource use, or export compatibility.
standard_en.whenToUse: Start on the default, then change gear according to your VRAM, quality or compatibility goal.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not stack several aggressive experimental gears before running a short controlled test.

optionDescriptions.velocity: Predicts the velocity field v, common in flow/RF.
optionDescriptions.sample: Predicts the clean image directly; the high-noise range is often harder to train.
